leftSuffix.description: left value suffix for columns that overlap and are not merging

rightSuffix.description: right value suffix for columns that overlap and are not merging

key.description: set of fieldnames that represent the key(s) of the "left" type in the merge operation

fkey.description: set of fieldnames that represent the foreign key(s) of the "right" type in the merge operation

kind.description:
